title: Quad sets
instructions: Sit with your leg straight on the floor. Tighten your thigh muscle and press the back of your knee down into the ground. Hold for 5 seconds, then relax.

title: Straight leg raise
instructions: Tighten your thigh muscle first, then lift your leg to the height of the other knee. Hold for one second, then lower slowly.

title: Heel slides
instructions: Lie on your back. Slide your heel toward you until you feel a gentle stretch — not pain. Slide back out slowly. Keep the movement smooth.
safetyNote: Gentle stretch only. Stop if you feel sharp pain.

title: Foam rolling — quads and calves
instructions: Roll slowly along each muscle, spending about 20 seconds on any tender spot. Never roll directly over the knee joint itself.
safetyNote: Avoid rolling directly on the knee joint.

title: Terminal knee extension (TKE)
instructions: Anchor a resistance band behind you at knee height. Loop it around the back of your knee. Stand slightly inside the band, bend the knee a little, then straighten it fully against the band.

title: Bird dog
instructions: Start on hands and knees. Extend your opposite arm and leg at the same time, keeping your back flat and hips level. Hold for two seconds, return, and switch sides.

title: Cat-camel stretch
instructions: On hands and knees. Arch your back toward the ceiling (cat), hold for 3 seconds, then let it drop toward the floor (camel). Move slowly and breathe.

title: Pendulum swings
instructions: Lean forward and let your arm hang freely. Gently swing it in small circles — clockwise then counterclockwise. Let gravity do the work; do not force the movement.
safetyNote: Gentle motion only. Stop if pain increases.

title: Band external rotation
instructions: Loop a band around a fixed point at elbow height. Hold the band with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, arm close to your side. Rotate your forearm away from your body, then return slowly.

title: Cervical retraction (chin tuck)
instructions: Sit tall. Gently draw your chin straight back — like making a double chin — without tilting your head. Hold for 5 seconds and release. Keep your teeth lightly together.
safetyNote: Gentle movement only. Stop if pain or dizziness occurs.
